lines: d15: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Alejandra Jadhav is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d15: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d15: 🕯️ Alejandra Jadhav is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d15: What Alejandra kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d15: "Alejandra's gone." Terry looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Alejandra." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d15: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Krishna blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d15: ★ The record corrects itself: this was never Wild Ginger — it's Hickory Nuts. Terry taught you wrong (their own memory). (The Codex marks the disagreement. You can call them out in conversation.)
d15: 📖 LEARNED: Stone & Masonry (Level 1). Stack stone so it stands: batter the wall, heart it with rubble, cap it well.
d15: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d15: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d15: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d15: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Alejandra Jadhav, 15 days. The mantle passes to Krishna Deshmukh.
d15: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Krishna Deshmukh, 41 — a mason. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d15: The village's quarrel was with Alejandra — and Alejandra is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d15: At the grave, Terry, Jordan, Carlos speak for Krishna — "Alejandra trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d15: The fire knew Krishna before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
